title: Sign-in now takes 2.8 minutes
about: The code step moved first and the second password screen is gone. A returning user is in under three minutes.

understood.label: You asked
understood.text: Make sign-in on a phone quicker.

understood.label: Done when
understood.text: Median under three minutes on the real flow.

visual.heading: Median sign-in fell from 4.5 to 2.8 minutes
visual.text: Minutes from the first screen to the home screen, 200 phone sign-ins before and after.

sections.heading: What changed for people
sections.body: Two screens did most of the waiting. Both are gone.

items.title: Code arrives with the password
items.text: The text is sent on the first tap.
items.more: People no longer wait for the message after typing a password.

sections.heading: What I did not check
sections.body: Tablets and the desktop flow were not measured.

next.heading: Nothing needs you
lines: I watch sign-ins for a week and file a note if they drop.
